remarks: According to Albert, “In the course of the demolition of the old organ in the Stiftskirche in the year 1903, a tenor trombone was found, which today is on display in the Schatzkammer. The instrument measures 1.8m with the slide closed and has the following inscription: [see above].”³  Examined by Carter, 2005.
